title: Golden Harvest Comfort

diffuser.notes: Use in a cool-mist diffuser for 30–45 minutes.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist linens or air.

why_it_works: Sweet orange and cinnamon evoke cozy autumn warmth, while cedarwood adds grounding depth and ginger brings a subtle spicy lift—together they create a comforting, harvest-like atmosphere.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
Cinnamon may be sensitizing; use low drops and avoid on sensitive skin.
